references.text: Detailed instructions on how the table of showbread (הַשֻּׁלְחָן) was to be made, along with its utensils and equipment.
Detailed instructions on how the pure lampstand (הַמְּנֹרָה הַטְּהֹרָה) was to be made with all its utensils.
Detailed instructions on how the altar of incense (מִזְבַּח הַקְּטֹרֶת) was to be made and used.
Bezalel makes the table of showbread and its utensils in accordance with the instructions.
Bezalel makes the pure lampstand and all its utensils in accordance with the instructions.
Bezalel makes the altar of incense in accordance with the instructions.
A listing of the finished items, including the table, the lampstand, and the altar of incense, which were brought to Moses.
Moses sets up the table, the lampstand, and the altar of incense in the tabernacle.
Instructions on how the Levites were to carry the table and the lampstand with their utensils during the journey.
The book of Hebrews describes the first tent with its lampstand, table, and showbread as part of the earthly sanctuary.
This verse presents the same list of sacred furnishings as a response to God's instructions in chapter 30, emphasizing the completion of the work.
Connects these same sacred furnishings to the Levites' responsibility to carry them and maintain the service during the wilderness journey.
